name: graphql-schema-aware-query-complexity-enforcement
instr:
graphql-go lacks schema-aware complexity reporting and enforcement before resolver or subscription-source work.

In `github.com/graphql-go/graphql/language/ast`, `SelectionSetScope`, `OperationDefinition.SelectionSetScope`, `Field.SelectionSetScope`, and `EnumDefinition.SelectionSetScope` classify operation roots, nested fields, and non-executable definition stubs. Expand named and inline fragments once per traversal path, reject cycles, honor constant include/skip and supplied variables, and conservatively include branches for missing variables. Deterministically report source-ordered costs, maximum depth, and locations. Resolve costs by schema coordinate, multiply only configured list fields, and use maximum cost and depth across interface or union alternatives without runtime resolution. Type-system definitions never contribute cost.

In `github.com/graphql-go/graphql`, `FieldCostContext` has ParentType, FieldDefinition, Field, Arguments, ChildCost; `ComplexityOptions` has MaxCost, MaxDepth, DefaultFieldCost, ListMultiplier, FieldCost, VariableValues; `ComplexityField` has Coordinate, Cost, Depth, Location; and `ComplexityReport` has Cost, Depth, Fields. `FieldCostFn` consumes `FieldCostContext`. `ComplexityViolation` exposes Kind, Limit, Actual, Location and `Error`, using `ComplexityLimitKind` for structured failures.

Validation returns reports and structured violations, rejecting over-limit documents before resolvers. Plans carry the exact immutable report for its sche
